Name: Spouse Homemaker
Author: s1enderrr77
Description:
Spouse Homemaker / 会过日子的伴侣
Supported languages: English, 简体中文 (中文说明在下方)

======================================================================
ENGLISH
======================================================================

Married life in vanilla goes quiet fast. With this mod, your spouse (or roommate) actually keeps house: they cook real recipes with the ingredients you leave them, and slowly decorate the farmhouse with a sense of style, telling you why they chose each piece.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
COOKING
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- Mark any chest as "shared" by clicking the heart button on the left of the chest menu. The farmhouse fridge and mini-fridges are shared by default.
- Each morning, every partner has a chance (default 40%) to cook one dish using a REAL recipe. The ingredients are taken from shared storage.
- The dish goes into the fridge, or sometimes straight into your inventory.
- If only one ingredient is missing, your partner tells you what to pick up.
- Press L to open "Dishes I'd Like". Ticked dishes are cooked much more often when the ingredients are available.
- All 12 vanilla spouses and Krobus have their own lines. Other NPCs use generic dialogue.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
DECORATING
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- Your partner places furniture, wallpaper and flooring taken from shared chests, from catalogues placed in the house, or wallpaper and flooring they make themselves from raw materials (default: 10 fiber + 2 sap for wallpaper; 20 wood or 20 stone for flooring).
- Each room gets a style (Scandinavian, Japandi, Country cottage, Mid-century, Classic, Bohemian, Coastal, Dark academia, Industrial or Pastel), and colors are chosen with the 60-30-10 rule in mind. Every spouse has favorite styles.
- Sensible placement: lamps and plants flank sofas and beds, symmetrically when possible; chairs face tables; rugs go in front of sofas and beside beds; paintings hang above the main piece; large pieces are centered on walls.
- Paths from the door to the bed, kitchen, spouse room and every room are always kept clear.
- Room limits stop the house from filling up with tables and chairs.
- Your partner explains their choices in dialogue, for example: "I added the lamp to the living room. Its wood tone goes well with the sofa. I put it on the other side of the sofa, so it mirrors the other lamp."
- When a room needs something that isn't available, your partner will ask you for it.
- Furniture sets: your partner sometimes places a whole set (tea corner, table for two, reading nook, sofa wall, and more).
- Share your own layouts: arrange a group of furniture, stand in the middle and type "homemaker_export <name>" in the SMAPI console. The template is saved in the mod's assets/templates folder. Send that file to others and they can drop it into the same folder.
- Your partner may also tidy up: move pieces standing in the middle of a room against a wall, or put surplus furniture away.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
YOU STAY IN CONTROL
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- Point at a piece of furniture and press U to lock it. Locked pieces are never touched. Beds, storage furniture, fish tanks and catalogues are never touched either.
- Press K to open the partner's log: what was cooked, used, placed, moved or put away.
- "Undo all decorating" in the log returns everything: placed furniture goes back into a shared chest, moved furniture goes back to where it was, and wallpaper and flooring are restored.
- Your partner never uses the last 1 of any item, and never uses items worth more than 1000g (both adjustable).
- If you remove something your partner placed, they won't place that item again.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
INSTALLATION
----------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Install the latest SMAPI.
2. Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu, to change settings in game. Otherwise, edit config.json after running the game once.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
CONSOLE COMMANDS (for testing)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
homemaker_cook                    Cook now
homemaker_decor                  Decorate now
homemaker_decor template          Try a furniture set only
homemaker_decor wallpaper        Try wallpaper / flooring only
homemaker_decor tidy              Tidy existing furniture only
homemaker_export <name> [radius]  Export nearby furniture as a template
homemaker_reload                  Reload template files
homemaker_restore                Undo all decorating
homemaker_lock_all / homemaker_unlock_all

----------------------------------------------------------------------
COMPATIBILITY
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5 or later. PC only.
- Works with custom NPCs that can marry or become roommates.
- Multiple spouses should work but has not been tested.
- Multiplayer: only the host's partners cook and decorate.
- Shared Fridge With Spouse: both mods take food from the fridge. They don't conflict, but food goes faster.
- Mods that move or reshape the spouse room or farmhouse: decorating follows the game's own room data, but unusual layouts may give odd results.
- If the heart button overlaps another mod's buttons (for example Chests Anywhere), move it in the config.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
KNOWN LIMITATIONS
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- Colors are estimated from item sprites, so they're only roughly right.
- A room's style can't be changed once chosen yet.
- Decoration reasons use shared lines, not per-spouse lines.
- Back up your save before trying it for the first time.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
AI DISCLOSURE
----------------------------------------------------------------------
The code of this mod was written with AI assistance (Claude by Anthropic). The idea, design decisions and in-game testing are my own. The dialogue was drafted with AI and reviewed by me. No AI-generated art is used.


======================================================================
中文
======================================================================

原版结婚后，伴侣很快就没什么存在感了。装上这个 mod，伴侣会真正过起日子：用你留下的食材按菜谱做饭，按自己的审美一点点布置农舍，还会告诉你为什么这样摆。

----------------------------------------------------------------------
做饭
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- 打开箱子，点左侧的爱心按钮就能把它设为"共享"。农舍里的冰箱和迷你冰箱默认共享。
- 每天早上，每位伴侣有一定概率（默认 40%）按真实菜谱做一道菜，食材从共享箱里扣。
- 做好的菜放进冰箱，有时直接放进你的背包。
- 只差一种食材时，伴侣会告诉你缺什么。
- 按 L 打开"想吃的菜"清单，勾选的菜在食材够时会优先做。
- 原版 12 位可结婚对象和科罗布斯都有专属台词，其他 NPC 用通用台词。

----------------------------------------------------------------------
布置房间
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- 伴侣会用共享箱里的家具、墙纸、地板，或者从家里摆着的目录里拿，也会用原材料自己做墙纸地板（默认：墙纸 = 10 纤维 + 2 树液；地板 = 20 木头或 20 石头）。
- 每个房间会定一种风格（北欧、侘寂、田园、中古、古典、波西米亚、海岸、暗黑学院、工业、甜美），配色参考 60-30-10 原则。每位伴侣有自己偏爱的风格。
- 摆放有讲究：灯和盆栽摆在沙发、床两侧，能对称就对称；椅子面朝桌子；地毯铺在沙发前、床边；挂画挂在主家具正上方；大件摆在墙的正中。
- 门口到床、厨房、配偶房和各个房间的路线永远留空。
- 每个房间有数量上限，不会摆得满屋都是桌椅。
- 伴侣会在对话里说明理由，比如："我在客厅添了某某灯。它的木色和屋里的沙发很相配。我把它摆在沙发的另一边，正好和那边的灯对称。"
- 房间缺东西又找不到时，伴侣会开口跟你要。
- 成套模板：伴侣有时会摆一整套（茶歇角、双人餐桌、阅读角、沙发墙等）。
- 分享你的布局：摆好一组家具，站在中间，在 SMAPI 窗口输入 homemaker_export 名字，模板会存进 mod 的 assets/templates 文件夹。把这个文件发给别人，对方放进同一个文件夹就能用。
- 伴侣也会整理：把摆在屋子中间的家具挪到墙边，或者把多余的收起来。

----------------------------------------------------------------------
一切由你掌控
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- 鼠标指着家具按 U 可以锁定，锁定的家具伴侣不会动。床、储物柜、鱼缸、目录本来就不会动。
- 按 K 打开伴侣的记录：做了什么、用了什么、摆了什么、挪了什么、收了什么。
- 记录面板里的"一键还原布置"：伴侣摆的家具收回共享箱，挪过的挪回原处，墙纸地板恢复原样。
- 每种物品至少保留 1 份，售价超过 1000g 的物品不会动（都可以调）。
- 你收走伴侣摆的东西后，伴侣不会再摆同款。

----------------------------------------------------------------------
安装
----------------------------------------------------------------------
1. 安装最新版 SMAPI。
2. 把本 mod 解压到 Stardew Valley/Mods 文件夹。
3. 用 SMAPI 启动游戏。

可选：安装 Generic Mod Config Menu 后可以在游戏里调整设置；没装的话，运行一次游戏后改 config.json。

----------------------------------------------------------------------
测试命令
----------------------------------------------------------------------
见英文部分的命令列表，用法相同。

----------------------------------------------------------------------
兼容性
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- 需要星露谷 1.6.15 和 SMAPI 4.5 或更高版本。仅支持电脑版。
- 支持可以结婚或成为室友的自定义 NPC。
- 多伴侣理论上可用，但没有测试过。
- 联机时只有房主的伴侣会做饭和布置。
- 和 Shared Fridge With Spouse 一起用不会冲突，但两个 mod 都会从冰箱拿东西，食物消耗会更快。
- 改动配偶房或农舍户型的 mod：布置会按游戏自己的房间数据走，但特殊户型可能效果不理想。
- 爱心按钮如果和其他 mod 的按钮重叠（比如 Chests Anywhere），可以在设置里挪位置。

----------------------------------------------------------------------
已知限制
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- 颜色是按物品贴图估算的，只是大致准确。
- 房间风格定下后暂时不能更改。
- 布置时说的理由是通用台词，没有按每位伴侣单独写。
- 第一次使用前请备份存档。

----------------------------------------------------------------------
AI 使用说明
----------------------------------------------------------------------
本 mod 的代码在 AI（Anthropic 的 Claude）协助下编写。创意、设计决策和游戏内测试由我本人完成。对话台词由 AI 起草、我审阅。没有使用 AI 生成的图片。
